package.description: Always send From the right Outlook account

en-US.description: Always send From the right Outlook account
en-US.longDescription: If you have multiple accounts in Outlook, it is important to use the right account for each recipient. For example, you would not want to email your business contact from a personal account. AccountCheck will help you get it right every time.
en-US.name: AccountCheck

zh-CN.description: 始终使用正确的 Outlook 账户发送邮件
zh-CN.longDescription: 如果你在 Outlook 中有多个账户，为每个收件人选择正确的账户非常重要。例如，你不希望使用个人账户向商业联系人发送邮件。AccountCheck 可帮助你每次都能准确无误地选择正确的账户。

package.longDescription: If you have multiple accounts in Outlook, it is important to use the right account for each recipient. For example, you would not want to email your business contact from a personal account. AccountCheck will help you get it right every time.
package.name: AccountCheck
